summary: Russia launched a massive overnight combined strike on Ukraine using 8 ballistic missiles, 4 cruise missiles, 1 anti-radar missile, 5 barrage munitions, and 146 attack UAVs, with Ukrainian air defense reporting 3 ballistic missiles and 129 UAVs destroyed but confirming 5 ballistic missiles, 1 anti-radar missile, and 16 UAVs hitting 15 locations. Multiple ballistic missiles struck Kyiv causing at least two impacts, while Russian forces also hit a Kyiv UAV production facility, Odesa port infrastructure, and Kryvyi Rih district killing one civilian and wounding three including a child. Simultaneously, ground fighting intensified across Sumy, Kharkiv, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson sectors per Ukrainian monitoring channels.
key_points: Russian overnight barrage included 8 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, 4 Kh-22/32 cruise missiles, 1 Kh-31P anti-radar missile, 5 Banderyol munitions, and 146 Shahed/Gerber/Italmas/Parodiya UAVs launched from multiple directions. (Source: @kpszsu/68667)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a large-scale combined missile and UAV attack overnight July 15-16 involving 8 ballistic missiles, 4 cruise missiles, 1 anti-radar missile, 5 barrage munitions, and 146 attack UAVs launched from Russian, occupied Ukrainian, and Crimean territory. Ukrainian air defense intercepted 3 ballistic missiles and 129 UAVs but confirmed 5 ballistic missiles, 1 anti-radar missile, and 16 UAVs struck 15 locations including Kyiv, where at least 4 ballistic missiles were launched and 2 impacts confirmed. Concurrently, Russian forces struck a Kyiv UAV production facility, Odesa port fuel infrastructure, and Kryvyi Rih district causing civilian casualties, while ground combat continued across northeastern, eastern, and southern fronts.

points: Ukrainian air defense forces engaged a massive multi-axis Russian attack overnight July 15-16, reporting destruction of 3 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and 129 Shahed/Gerber/Italmas/Parodiya UAVs across northern, southern, central, and eastern Ukraine using aviation, missile troops, EW units, mobile fire groups, and drone units. (Source: @kpszsu/68667)

Ukrainian monitoring channels tracked extensive inbound UAV activity across at least 8 oblasts including Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Kharkiv, Sumy, Odesa, and Zhytomyr, with specific sightings of reactive guided UAVs toward Synelnykove, Slavutych, Poltava, Ladyzhyn, Aviatorske, Shakhtarske, Ovidiopol, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, and Berdychiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/101218, @eRadarrua/101221, @eRadarrua/101232, @eRadarrua/101214, @kpszsu/68638, @kpszsu/68666, @kpszsu/68648, @kpszsu/68657, @kpszsu/68639, @kpszsu/68647, @kpszsu/68651, @mon1tor_ua/69012)

Kyiv air defense engaged at least 4 inbound ballistic missiles with monitoring channels confirming 2 clean hits in the city; air raid alerts and ballistic threat warnings persisted for hours. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69000, @mon1tor_ua/69006, @mon1tor_ua/69007, @mon1tor_ua/69001, @eRadarrua/101229)

Ukrainian forces continued ground operations in Sumy, Kharkiv, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson directions per Ukrainian-aligned reporting, with increased use of guided artillery rounds and hexacopter drones noted in Zaporizhzhia sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31635)

EU leaders including European Commission President von der Leyen and heads of state from Serbia, Moldova, Albania, plus prime ministers and foreign ministers arrived in Kyiv for the Ukraine-Southeast Europe summit with approximately 10 foreign delegations. (Source: @UkraineNow/82657)

Russian forces launched a coordinated overnight strike from multiple launch zones: 8 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles from Bryansk region, 4 Kh-22/32 cruise missiles from Black Sea waters, 1 Kh-31P anti-radar missile, 5 Banderyol barrage munitions, and 146 Shahed/Gerber/Italmas/Parodiya UAVs from Kursk, Orel, Millerovo (Russia), Donetsk (occupied), and Gvardeyskoye (occupied Crimea). (Source: @kpszsu/68667)

Russian Ministry of Defense claimed precision strikes on a Kyiv enterprise assembling Liutyi and Leleka-100 strike UAVs, and on port infrastructure in Odesa and Yuzhny hitting 5 fuel tanks. (Source: @tass_agency/385477, @tass_agency/385475)
Russian MoD reported destruction of 375 Ukrainian UAVs overnight over Russian regions by air defense forces. (Source: @tass_agency/385470)

Russian ground forces continued offensive operations in Sumy direction (Shostka district near Ulanovo, Malaya Sloboda; Sumy district in Ryzhovka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, forests south of Ivolzhansky; Krasnopolsky district forests and Prokhody village), Kharkiv direction (Kazachya Lopan, Volchansk area villages Volkhovskoye, Zakharovka, Yurchynkovo, Bely Kolodets, Velikoburluk area west of Petro-Ivanovka near Artelnoe, Budarki, Zemlyanka), Donetsk direction (Krasny Liman, Konstantinovka toward Alekseevo-Druzhkovka and Nikolaypolye), Zaporizhzhia direction (west of Rovnoye and Kopani), and Kherson direction (strikes on Nizhne Serogozy, Kakhovka, Aleksandrovka, Novaya Zburyevka, Askania-Nova). sections.threat_assessment: Russia's overnight barrage demonstrates sustained capacity for large-scale combined strikes using diverse launch platforms and munition types, with ballistic missiles penetrating Ukrainian air defense at a significant rate (5 of 8 Iskander-M/S-400 impacting). The targeting of Kyiv's UAV production facility and Odesa port fuel infrastructure indicates a deliberate campaign to degrade Ukraine's long-range strike capability and logistics. Continued ground pressure across multiple axes, particularly in Sumy and Kharkiv directions where Russian 'North' Group maintains offensive operations, suggests Russia is exploiting Ukrainian force dispersion. The high volume of reactive guided UAVs across western and central oblasts signals adaptation to penetrate deeper rear areas. Ukrainian air defense effectiveness remains high against UAVs (129/146) but ballistic missile interception rates require improvement.
sections.regional_response: The arrival of approximately 10 EU delegations including Commission President von der Leyen for the Ukraine-Southeast Europe summit underscores continued political solidarity despite the failure to agree on the 21st sanctions package, which was postponed to next week. Poland's foreign minister explicitly warned of potential Russian false-flag operations against NATO using Ukrainian drones as pretext, indicating heightened alliance vigilance. Russian deputy Security Council secretary Kokov cited growing EU public outrage over Ukrainian 'glorification of Nazism' referencing Volyn massacre commemorations, suggesting Moscow is amplifying historical narratives to fracture European unity. These dynamics reveal a dual-track Western approach: military support continuation alongside diplomatic friction management.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Two Majors summary (July 15) provides granular ground combat locations across five sectors, notably Russian use of heavy FABs for logistics interdiction at Krasny Liman and increased Ukrainian guided artillery/hexacopter employment in Zaporizhzhia. Russian MoD's claim of 375 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed overnight over Russian territory, if partially accurate, indicates massive Ukrainian drone sortie rates targeting Russian rear areas. The reported Crimean Bridge traffic disruption and air defense activity in Tula/eastern Crimea aligns with Ukrainian deep-strike patterns. Former Defense Minister's listed achievements (DeepStateUA) reveal Ukrainian institutional focus on drone procurement reform, logistics isolation of Crimea, and domestic missile development
